title: Star Watcher - Menu
brief: Title screen loop. SNES-style samples like the day/night loops, livelier and brighter: ocarina lead, dense celesta arpeggios, a quiet chip pulse in the return.

sections.intent: title theme on ocarina over a busy celesta arpeggio
answer: longer notes, minor iv and V
theme returns, celesta doubles it, chip arpeggio joins
